description.value: Gokudo Shabu Shabu is a Japanese-Taiwanese fusion hot pot restaurant where diners cook thinly sliced meats and fresh vegetables in simmering broth at their own table. The restaurant offers 17 unique soup bases — including Sukiyaki, Satay, and Spicy Mix — alongside house-crafted sauces developed by the founder's family. A value combo meal with soup, main, sides, vegetables, sauce, beverage, and dessert makes it a substantial stop for hungry cyclists passing through Burnaby.
